cream-reference-faithful.text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent character cutout for a throwaway SCAX UI comparison prototype
Primary request: Recreate the small assistant cat shown at the lower-right of the reference image as faithfully as practical, isolated as a clean full-body character asset.
Input image: reference image; the lower-right cat is the sole visual subject to reproduce. Ignore the surrounding application UI and speech bubble.
Subject: a very round cream-and-peach kitten mascot with an oversized head, tiny triangular ears, soft orange ear tips and head patches, large glossy dark gray-brown eyes, a tiny pale muzzle, subtle whisker marks, stubby arms held together near the chest, tiny feet, and a compact sitting pose.
Style/medium: polished soft 3D clay/plush render, gentle rounded geometry, professional mascot turntable quality.
Composition/framing: centered, front three-quarter view matching the reference pose, entire character visible, generous transparent padding, square canvas.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral studio light, friendly and calm.
Color palette: warm ivory, peach-orange accents, muted warm gray details.
Constraints: transparent background with genuine alpha; character only; preserve the distinctive proportions, pose, facial placement, and colors from the reference as closely as possible; no UI, no speech bubble, no text, no logo, no watermark, no floor plane, no cast shadow outside the character. This is a reference-faithful prototype asset, not a claim of original brand ownership.
